records.source: Ah, you got 'em. An exciting catch, aren't they?#$b#Here's 25 Calico Eggs for your reward.
records.translation: Ah, nahuli mo sila. Kapanapanabik silang hulihin, hindi ba?#$b#Narito ang 25 Itlog ng Calico bilang gantimpala mo.

records.source: Willy has challenged you to catch a Scorpion Carp.
records.translation: Hinamon ka ni Willy na manghuli ng Karpang Alakdan.

records.source: Ah, you did it. A challenging catch, don't you think?#$b#Here's 50 Calico Eggs for your reward.
records.translation: Ah, nagawa mo. Mahirap hulihin, hindi ba?#$b#Narito ang 50 Itlog ng Calico bilang gantimpala mo.

records.source: Willy has challenged you to find a "Golden Bobber".
records.translation: Hinamon ka ni Willy na hanapin ang "Ginintuang Palutang".

records.source: Well, if it isn't me favorite golden bobber!#$b#And it only smells mild o' fish... Heh heh.$h#$b#Here's 30 Calico Eggs for your reward.
records.translation: Aba, ito pala ang paborito kong Ginintuang Palutang!#$b#At bahagya lamang itong amoy-isda... Heh heh.$h#$b#Narito ang 30 Itlog ng Calico bilang gantimpala mo.

records.source: Willy's Challenge: Catch a Scorpion Carp.
records.translation: Hamon ni Willy: Manghuli ng Karpang Alakdan.

records.source: Willy: A fish swallowed me rare golden bobber! There's 30 eggs for whoever returns it.
records.translation: Willy: Nilunok ng isda ang bihirang Ginintuang Palutang ko! May 30 itlog para sa sinumang magsauli nito.

records.source: Find and return Willy's Golden Bobber.
records.translation: Hanapin at isauli ang Ginintuang Palutang ni Willy.

records.source: Scholar: Forgive me, friend. But I cannot engage with you until the festival is open.
records.translation: Pantas: Paumanhin, kaibigan. Hindi ako maaaring makipag-usap sa iyo hangga't hindi bukas ang pista.

records.source: Scholar: Greetings, friend! Care for a test of knowledge? If you can answer my questions correctly, you'll earn a prize. What do you say?
records.translation: Pantas: Pagbati, kaibigan! Gusto mo bang subukin ang iyong kaalaman? Kapag nasagot mo nang tama ang mga tanong ko, makakakuha ka ng premyo. Ano sa palagay mo?

records.source: Scholar: Excellent! Now, for the first question...
records.translation: Pantas: Mahusay! Ngayon, para sa unang tanong...

records.source: Scholar: Correct!
records.translation: Pantas: Tama!

records.source: Scholar: Very Good! I'm impressed with your knowledge, friend. Here is your prize.
records.translation: Pantas: Napakahusay! Humahanga ako sa kaalaman mo, kaibigan. Narito ang premyo mo.

records.source: Scholar: Wrong! ...I'm sorry, friend. But you will have to come back another time.
records.translation: Pantas: Mali! ...Paumanhin, kaibigan. Kailangan mong bumalik sa ibang pagkakataon.

records.source: Scholar: ...I'm sorry, friend. But you will have to come back next time.
records.translation: Pantas: ...Paumanhin, kaibigan. Kailangan mong bumalik sa susunod.

records.source: Scholar: Enjoy the eggs, my friend. I'll be back next year for another challenge.
records.translation: Pantas: Sana'y masiyahan ka sa mga itlog, kaibigan. Babalik ako sa susunod na taon para sa panibagong hamon.
